dimensions.label: Pricing mechanism
dimensions.a: One Email plan priced only by active-profile count, with no seat limit at any tier
dimensions.b: Four named plans (Starter, Plus, Pro and Enterprise) priced by contact-count band, each bundling more CRM, automation actions and seats as you go up

dimensions.label: Cheapest paid plan, at 1,000 contacts/profiles
dimensions.a: $30/mo (Email, 1,000 active profiles), billed monthly — no annual option on the pricing page
dimensions.b: $15/mo (Starter, 1,000 contacts), billed annually only — no self-serve monthly rate is published

dimensions.label: Billing cadence you can actually get self-serve
dimensions.a: Monthly only, by credit card, with no annual discount published for any plan
dimensions.b: Annual only on the public pricing page; a Monthly cadence exists per the Help Center, but its rate has never been published

dimensions.label: Team seats included and the cost to add more
dimensions.a: No seat limit or seat charge at any tier — price is set purely by profile count
dimensions.b: Fixed seats per plan (Starter 1, Plus 1, Pro 3, Enterprise 5); extra seats are purchasable but no price is published anywhere public

dimensions.label: Built-in sales CRM with a pipeline
dimensions.a: Calls itself a "B2C CRM" built on customer profiles, but has no deal-pipeline or sales-rep tooling
dimensions.b: A CRM and pipeline ship on every paid plan, including Starter; Pipelines and Sales Engagement add-ons go further on Plus and up, though their price is unpublished

dimensions.label: Ecommerce-specific features
dimensions.a: Flows read Shopify and WooCommerce order and browsing history natively; a Reviews add-on ($25/mo, up to 250 orders/month) is scoped to store order volume
dimensions.b: Lists Shopify and WooCommerce among 1,000+ integrations, but has no order-volume-priced add-on comparable to Klaviyo's Reviews

dimensions.label: SMS marketing cost
dimensions.a: Native and usage-priced: $0.01 per US toll-free segment sent, carrier fees included
dimensions.b: An SMS add-on exists on Plus and up, but its credit price is shown only inside an in-app purchase modal after signing in

dimensions.label: Free access before you pay anything
dimensions.a: A free-forever plan, up to 250 active profiles and 500 emails/month, with no time limit
dimensions.b: No free plan at all — only a 14-day trial that runs on Pro-plan features, no card required

dimensions.label: Refund or guarantee if it's not a fit
dimensions.a: None stated; canceling immediately rather than at the end of the billing cycle forfeits the rest of the paid month
dimensions.b: A 30-day money-back guarantee on every paid plan

verdicts.why: An agency managing several clients' lead pipelines gets a CRM and pipeline on every ActiveCampaign plan, including Starter, while Klaviyo has no pipeline tooling at all.

A course creator's list rarely comes from ecommerce order data or a sales pipeline, so Klaviyo's Shopify- and WooCommerce-specific tools and ActiveCampaign's CRM both solve a problem most course businesses don't have.
Klaviyo's flows are built directly on Shopify order and browsing history, with a Reviews add-on priced by store order volume that ActiveCampaign has no equivalent for.
A business selling appointments and quotes rather than a product catalog gets more use from ActiveCampaign's built-in CRM and pipeline than from Klaviyo's ecommerce-scoped add-ons.
Klaviyo's free-forever plan lets a freelancer start at $0 and pay monthly with no annual commitment, while ActiveCampaign has no free tier and publishes its price only on an annual bill.
A software startup doing sales-led growth needs the CRM and pipeline that ship on every ActiveCampaign plan more than it needs Klaviyo's Shopify- and WooCommerce-specific integrations.
